interpretation: Thirty finite original-edge contexts, with all literal original solutions retained in references.json. Both modes use historical neighbour-only cycle contexts, complete shared-interface intersections and original-cycle closure. Only automatic named nine-point factors differ. Complete original-edge/pin solutions are checked against every recorded reduction domain, elimination source domain, full input relation, saved reconstruction fibre and learned factor/event row. Unsatisfiable preservation is vacuous; their complete independent enumeration and decision agree. The initial structural equality rows retain all four literal colours; no case colour is written before full elimination. Matching covers this named 21-edge non-induced pattern only, never arbitrary joint restrictions or all graphs.
